name: hgi_qdq_tsplit_ctl_r3-ctlr3-892340814
purpose: Strap-latency QUANT transport controller for the d4g split r2: one closed tile for any die relay count. Bench = the exact split r2 lockstep against the monolith at XR 0 (RLI 11/WCI 6) and XR 12 (RLI 35/WCI 18).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hgi_qdq_transport_ctl_r3 #(.NPMAX(48), .WCMAX(32), .DL(25), .MUT(0)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/qw/static/ot_hgi_qdq_transport_r3.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: QDQ_SPLIT_R2_mutant2
bench.why: 12 relay stages present, straps priced for 11: the controller rr_v check / write timing is one edge off

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hgi_qdq_tsplit_ctl_r3/signoff_ffrepair.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hgi_qdq_tsplit_ctl_r3/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hgi_qdq_tsplit_ctl_r3 --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_hgi_qdq_transport_ctl_r3  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: ctl r3: ctl_r2 (cmd pin registers + reset relay, native PASS) with the read round trip / write commit as registered STRAPS instead of parameters (strap-selected taps on the command and commit pipelines, NPMAX 48 / WCMAX 32, out-of-range strap = sticky fault). Closed once for every die relay count XR and VM latency RL (7, or 9 with share2); the v1/r2 views are closed only at RL9/WC5, which the split r2 (LG r2 +2/dir, XR relays) never uses.
